facts.fact: 吻后 Vero 趁机把手铐铐在 Kayla 腕上让两人整场追逐锁在一起，理由是 Clay 是不稳定因素，他靠近必须先过自己这关
facts.anchor: This way, if he gets close to her, he has to get past me as well.

facts.fact: Clay 因 Kayla 在表单上填他名字而失控，Brawley 当众站 Clay 一边，Vero 因此觉得被伴侣背弃
facts.anchor: Clay had a meltdown over Kayla putting his name on the form. Clearly, she knew it would piss him off, and it did, but Brawley took his side.

facts.fact: 配对由 Nixie 最终决定；本周她不知为何仍告诉 Clay 他可以参与
facts.anchor: Nixie gets the final say in who is paired, and I don’t know what Clay did to piss her off this week, but she told him he was in.

facts.fact: Vero 上岛三年从未吓到过稻草人 Cave，这件事他连对 Brawley 都绝口不提
facts.anchor: I have been on this island for three years, and I have never once successfully rattled him—it bothers me more than I will ever say out loud to anyone, including Brawley.

facts.fact: 玉米地里 Vero 命令 Kayla 别停别看不别回应，她从他语气里听出真实恐惧
facts.anchor: I said, keep moving, Kayla,” I snap, and she must hear some of the fear in my voice because she moves faster.

facts.fact: Cave 常年住在玉米地、吓孩子超过限度，Nixie 因不信任他至今未让他参加正式追逐
facts.anchor: Nixie hasn’t let him do a real chase yet because she doesn’t trust him.

facts.fact: 墓园里 Clay 似乎算准两人路线提前埋伏，把他们扑倒压在墓碑间
facts.anchor: It’s like he planned exactly where we would be, knew the moment we would get there, and waited.

facts.fact: 精神病院房间有 Vero 专用的隐藏出口，两人靠它绕开正在砸门的 Brawley
facts.anchor: There is a hidden exit over there—it’s how I get in and out.
